credit: © NASA — Apollo 16 LRV traverse (Descartes Highlands, Apr 1972; ~27 km over three EVAs). The route connects published traverse-station coordinates — North Ray crater (Station 11, ~4.4 km north), the LM 'Orion', Plum/Flag crater (Station 1) and the Cinco craters on Stone Mountain (Station 4, ~4 km south) — from Wikipedia and the-moon.us crater positions. Station-waypoint approximation of the north–south traverse; the fully surveyed LROC track is a future upgrade (Apollo 17 uses the complete USGS mapped traverse).
